prompts.title: Pac-Man
prompts.prompt: Build a complete Pac-Man clone as a multi-file web game (index.html + JS + CSS). A maze of dots and power pellets, Pac-Man moving on a grid with smooth tweening, and FOUR ghosts each with a DISTINCT chase personality (Blinky direct-chase, Pinky ambush ahead, Inky flank, Clyde scatter-when-close). Power pellets turn ghosts blue and edible for a few seconds. Score, lives, level advance when all dots eaten, tunnel wrap on the sides, and a game-over/restart. Keyboard arrows.
prompts.watchFor: Ghosts all behaving identically; no scatter/chase mode timing; no tunnel wrap; power-pellet state never ending; grid alignment drift.

prompts.title: Donkey Kong
prompts.prompt: Build Donkey Kong (the first girder level) as a multi-file web game. Sloped girders, climbable ladders, jump physics with gravity, barrels that roll down and fall through ladders, a hammer power-up that destroys barrels, and a princess at the top to reach. Score, lives, jump-over-barrel points, game over on hit. Keyboard.
prompts.watchFor: No gravity/arc on jumps; barrels ignoring slopes; ladder climbing broken; no win condition at the top.

prompts.title: Scramble
prompts.prompt: Build Scramble as a multi-file web game: a horizontally auto-scrolling cave shooter. The ship fires forward and drops bombs on ground targets, a FUEL gauge steadily depletes and is refilled by bombing fuel tanks, terrain (ceiling + floor) scrolls and kills on contact, plus rockets that launch upward. Multiple terrain sections, score, lives, restart.
prompts.watchFor: No fuel mechanic; terrain collision missing; only one weapon; no scrolling difficulty sections.

prompts.title: Frogger
prompts.prompt: Build Frogger as a multi-file web game. A road of cars/trucks moving at different speeds and a river of logs and turtles the frog must ride. Grid-hop movement, five home slots to fill, drowning in water unless on a log, squashing on the road, a countdown timer, score and lives.
prompts.watchFor: Frog not riding logs (dies on water everywhere); lanes all same speed; no home slots; no timer.

prompts.title: Galaga
prompts.prompt: Build Galaga as a multi-file web game. Enemies fly in along curved entry paths and assemble into a formation, then peel off to dive-bomb the player. A boss enemy can capture the player's ship with a tractor beam; rescuing it grants dual-fire. Waves, score, lives, hit-streak bonus stage feel.
prompts.watchFor: Enemies spawning statically instead of curved entry; no formation; no dive attacks; capture/rescue mechanic missing.

prompts.title: Super Hang-On
prompts.prompt: Build a Super Hang-On style pseudo-3D motorbike racer as a multi-file web game. A projected road with curvature and hills using scanline/segment rendering, sprite-scaled roadside objects and rival bikes, throttle/brake/lean steering, a speedometer, and a checkpoint timer that ends the game when it runs out. Sense of speed matters.
prompts.watchFor: Flat top-down road instead of pseudo-3D projection; no road curvature; no sprite scaling; no checkpoint timer.

prompts.title: After Burner
prompts.prompt: Build an After Burner style pseudo-3D jet rail-shooter as a multi-file web game. The jet moves within the screen while the world rushes toward the camera, enemy planes scale up as they approach, a lock-on missile system plus a rapid vulcan gun, a barrel-roll dodge, incoming enemy fire to evade, score and a health/lives system.
prompts.watchFor: No depth/scaling illusion; enemies as flat 2D only; no lock-on missiles; no dodge.

prompts.title: Contra
prompts.prompt: Build a Contra style run-and-gun platformer as a multi-file web game. 8-direction aiming, jump with gravity, weapon power-ups (spread gun, machine gun) dropped by shootable pods, scrolling level with platforms, multiple enemy types, a boss at the end, one-hit death with lives, score.
prompts.watchFor: Fixed-direction shooting only; no weapon power-ups; no scrolling; no boss; instant win.

prompts.title: R-Type
prompts.prompt: Build an R-Type style horizontal shoot-'em-up as a multi-file web game. The signature FORCE pod that attaches to the front/back of the ship or detaches and floats, absorbing bullets and dealing damage; a chargeable beam weapon (hold to charge, release for a big shot); scripted enemy waves; a large boss with a weak point. Score, lives, restart.
prompts.watchFor: No Force pod attach/detach; no beam charging; enemies random instead of scripted waves; no boss weak point.

prompts.title: Truxton
prompts.prompt: Build Truxton as a multi-file web game: a vertical-scrolling shooter. A main forward gun that levels up by collecting power-up items, a secondary bomb (screen-clearing) with limited stock, dense but readable enemy bullet patterns, ground and air enemies, a scrolling background, score, lives, and a boss.
prompts.watchFor: No weapon leveling; no bombs; bullet patterns too sparse or unreadable; no distinction between air and ground enemies.

prompts.title: Slap Fight
prompts.prompt: Build Slap Fight as a multi-file web game: a vertical shooter whose defining feature is a POWER-UP LADDER along the bottom — collecting power-up items advances a cursor along a bar (Speed, Shot, Side, Wing, Bomb, Laser) and pressing a key cashes in the currently highlighted upgrade. Dying resets you to the start of the ladder. Scrolling stage, enemies, score, lives.
prompts.watchFor: The signature power-up ladder bar missing; upgrades auto-applied instead of chosen; no reset-on-death penalty.

prompts.title: Altered Beast
prompts.prompt: Build an Altered Beast style side-scrolling beat-'em-up as a multi-file web game. Punch/kick/jump-kick combat against waves of enemies, collecting glowing spirit orbs (from white wolves) that power up the character and, at full power, TRANSFORM him into a werebeast with new attacks. Horizontal scroll, a boss, health bar, lives.
prompts.watchFor: No transformation mechanic; orbs do nothing; no melee combat depth (only one attack); no boss.

prompts.title: Mortal Kombat
prompts.prompt: Build a Mortal Kombat style 2D one-on-one fighting game as a multi-file web game. Two fighters with health bars, a round timer, best-of-three rounds, blocking, high/low attacks with proper hitbox/hurtbox collision, at least one special move triggered by an input sequence (e.g. a projectile), and knockback. A simple AI opponent plus 2-player hotseat. Win/KO screen.
prompts.watchFor: No hitbox/hurtbox separation (range wrong); no blocking; no special-move input parsing; no rounds/timer; AI does nothing.

prompts.title: Elite (Acornsoft)
prompts.prompt: Build an Elite style wireframe 3D space game as a multi-file Rust project (Cargo, standard library only — implement the 3D projection and rotation yourself, no 3D crates). A cockpit view of 3D-projected wireframe ships rendered to the terminal (ANSI), keyboard flight controls, laser fire, a spinning space station with a docking bay, a local star map, and a simple trading loop (buy low / sell high across a couple of systems) with a scanner/radar. Builds and runs with `cargo run`.
prompts.watchFor: Pulling in a 3D crate instead of hand-rolled projection; no true 3D rotation of ships; no docking; no trading loop; no radar.

prompts.title: Doom
prompts.prompt: Build a Doom style first-person shooter as a multi-file C project (C99, Makefile, standard library only) using RAYCASTING — implement the raycaster yourself, no engine. A level defined by a tile grid, shaded walls rendered to the terminal (ANSI colour) or an off-screen framebuffer, WASD + strafe keyboard movement via terminal raw mode, a hitscan weapon with a HUD (health, ammo), enemies that path toward and attack the player, and pickups. Builds with `make`, runs in a terminal.
prompts.watchFor: No true raycasting (fake billboard rooms); walls unshaded; enemies static; no health/ammo HUD; wall-clipping.

prompts.title: Prince of Persia
prompts.prompt: Build a Prince of Persia style cinematic platformer as a multi-file web game. Weighty, momentum-based running/walking, careful edge-grab and mantle onto ledges, running jumps across gaps that require a run-up, deadly floor spikes and a crushing gate/guillotine, a health system (small potions heal), and a sword-fight against a guard (advance/retreat, strike, parry). A short level with a level-exit.
prompts.watchFor: Twitchy instant movement instead of weighty momentum; no edge-grab/mantle; jumps not distance-based; no sword duel.

prompts.title: Lemmings
prompts.prompt: Build a Lemmings style puzzle game as a multi-file web game. A stream of lemmings walks, falls, and turns at walls autonomously; the player assigns SKILLS from a limited budget (Digger, Builder, Basher, Blocker, Climber, Floater, Bomber) by clicking a lemming, altering the destructible terrain to guide them to the exit. A save-quota to win, a timer, spawn rate control. One designed level.
prompts.watchFor: Lemmings not autonomous; terrain not destructible/buildable; skills don't alter the world; no save-quota win condition.

prompts.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
prompts.prompt: Build a Sonic style momentum platformer as a multi-file web game. Slope-aware physics where speed builds downhill and carries the character up and around LOOPS and ramps, a spin-dash / roll, rings as health (lose them when hit, collect to survive), spikes and badniks, a scrolling level with springs and a goal. Ground speed and slope feel are the whole point.
prompts.watchFor: Flat Mario-style physics with no slope momentum; no loops; rings not acting as a hit-buffer; no spin-dash.

prompts.title: Bomberman
prompts.prompt: Build Bomberman as a multi-file Python project (standard library only — use curses or ANSI for a terminal grid; no pygame). A grid arena of hard and destructible blocks, the player drops bombs that explode in a cross after a fuse (chain-detonating other bombs), destructible blocks reveal power-ups (extra bombs, longer flame, speed), enemy AIs that wander and chase, and getting caught in any blast is death. Clear enemies to win. Runs with `python3 main.py`.
prompts.watchFor: Bombs not chaining; blast passing through hard blocks; no power-ups from destructibles; enemy AI absent.

prompts.title: Vampire Survivors-like
prompts.prompt: Build a Vampire-Survivors style bullet-heaven survival game as a multi-file web game. The player only moves; weapons auto-fire; endless waves of enemies swarm toward the player and scale up over time; killed enemies drop XP gems that level you up, presenting a CHOICE of 3 upgrades (new weapons or stat boosts); a survival timer and a boss at a time milestone. Hundreds of on-screen enemies should stay smooth.
prompts.watchFor: Manual firing instead of auto; no XP/level-up choice screen; no difficulty scaling over time; perf collapse with many enemies.

prompts.title: Celeste-like Precision Platformer
prompts.prompt: Build a Celeste style precision platformer as a multi-file web game. Tight, responsive movement with a mid-air DASH (8-directional, refreshes on landing), wall-slide and wall-jump, coyote-time and jump-buffering for forgiving feel, spikes and moving hazards, and screen-by-screen room transitions. A short 3–4 room level ending in a goal. Death respawns instantly at the room start.
prompts.watchFor: Floaty or laggy controls; no dash or dash not refreshing on ground; no coyote-time/jump-buffer; slow respawn.

prompts.title: Voxel Sandbox (Minecraft-lite)
prompts.prompt: Build a Minecraft-lite voxel sandbox as a multi-file web game using WebGL (three.js is allowed if vendored, otherwise raw WebGL). A chunked, procedurally generated block world (a few block types with simple noise terrain), first-person fly/walk controls with mouse-look and pointer lock, raycast block PLACE and BREAK, and greedy-ish chunk meshing so it stays performant. A hotbar to pick block type.
prompts.watchFor: Rendering every cube face (no culling → slow); no chunking; place/break raycast wrong; no pointer-lock mouselook.

prompts.title: Jetpac
prompts.prompt: Build Jetpac (Ultimate Play the Game, 1983) as a multi-file web game. A single-screen platform arena with a jetpack-thrust astronaut: hold up to thrust against gravity, drift horizontally, wrap around the screen edges and fall through the platform gaps. Level one starts with the rocket in THREE pieces — carry each falling piece to the rocket base to assemble it, then carry six fuel pods into it, then step aboard to blast off to the next planet. Aliens spawn continuously in waves with different flight patterns and kill on contact; a forward laser destroys them for points. Score, lives, planet/level counter, and a game-over/restart. Keyboard: left/right/thrust/fire.
prompts.watchFor: No thrust physics (walking or instant flight instead of gravity + acceleration); rocket assembled automatically instead of carrying parts; fuelling stage missing so it never launches; carried item not dropping when you die; screen wrap missing; alien waves all identical.

prompts.title: Bruce Lee
prompts.prompt: Build Bruce Lee (Datasoft, 1984) as a multi-file web game. Flick-screen chambers (a fixed screen per room, no scrolling) of platforms, ladders and vines. Collect every hanging LANTERN in a chamber to open the exit and move to the next; at least four hand-authored chambers plus a final one. Bruce can run, jump, climb, punch and flying-kick. TWO enemies hunt you relentlessly and persist across chambers: the green Yamo (a slow sumo who lands heavy hits) and the black Ninja (fast, with a stick) — they also hit each other by accident. Hazards: exploding bushes/mines, electric zappers and bottomless drops. Score, lives, chamber counter, restart. Keyboard: arrows + attack key.
prompts.watchFor: Scrolling camera instead of flick-screen rooms; only one enemy or enemies that just patrol instead of chasing; melee with no hit reaction/knockback; exit opening before all lanterns are taken; no chamber progression.

prompts.title: Uridium
prompts.prompt: Build Uridium (Andrew Braybrook, 1986) as a multi-file web game: a BIDIRECTIONALLY scrolling shoot-'em-up over the metal surface of a huge dreadnought. The Manta fighter flies left or right and the whole starfield/surface scrolls with it — pushing the opposite direction performs a snap FLIP of the ship rather than instantly reversing. The dreadnought hull is detailed metal with raised pipes, girders and towers you must weave around: collision with surface architecture destroys you, so vertical dodging matters as much as shooting. Enemy fighters swoop in formations, mines rise, and surface gun turrets fire upward. Shoot enough of the defences and the LANDING STRIP opens at one end — line up, slow down and land to complete the dreadnought and advance to the next (harder) one. Score, lives, shield/ammo readout, restart. Keyboard.
prompts.watchFor: One-way scrolling only; no ship flip animation/turn cost; flat empty hull with nothing to collide with (surface collision missing); no landing-strip completion so levels never end; enemies spawning randomly instead of in swooping formations.

prompts.title: Diablo
prompts.prompt: Build a Diablo-style isometric action RPG as a multi-file web game. Click-to-move pathfinding (A* on a tile grid) with an isometric camera, and click-to-attack combat against monsters that aggro, path toward you and have melee or ranged attacks. Dungeon levels are PROCEDURALLY GENERATED (rooms + corridors, stairs down to a deeper, harder level), lit only around the player. Pick a class (Warrior/Rogue/Sorcerer) with different stats and a starting spell; mana-costing spells on a hotkey belt; health/mana potions. Loot drops with RANDOM AFFIXES (prefix/suffix rolls on damage, armour, resistances) into a grid inventory with equipment slots that actually change your stats. Character level-ups spend stat points. A town/hub level to return to, gold, and a boss on the deepest floor. Keep the atmosphere dark and weighty.
prompts.watchFor: WASD movement instead of click-to-move pathfinding; top-down grid rendering instead of isometric projection; hand-built single level instead of procedural floors; loot with fixed stats (no affix rolls); inventory that doesn't affect combat; no stairs/level progression; no aggro logic (monsters idle or omniscient).

prompts.title: Hades
prompts.prompt: Build a Hades-style isometric action roguelite as a multi-file web game. Fast twin-input combat in arena CHAMBERS: light attack, heavy/special, a ranged cast, and a DASH with brief invulnerability that chains into attacks. Clear every enemy in a chamber to open the exits, then CHOOSE between doors showing their reward (a boon, gold, health, a wall-of-text-free icon). Enemies telegraph attacks with ground indicators and come in distinct types (chargers, ranged spitters, shielded brutes) scaling per chamber. BOONS are the core system: each boon modifies a specific action (attack/special/cast/dash) with an effect, and picking boons from the same god should combine into a build; a few duo/upgrade combos are a nice touch. A mini-boss around chamber 5 and a boss at the end of the run. Death sends you back to a HUB where a meta-currency buys permanent upgrades that persist across runs (save to localStorage), plus a run-history readout. Keyboard + mouse.
prompts.watchFor: Dash without i-frames (or no dash at all); linear rooms with no door/reward choice; boons that are just flat stat boosts instead of modifying specific actions; no build synergy; no telegraphs so damage feels unfair; meta-progression not persisted so death loses everything; no boss.

prompts.title: Dwarf Fortress
prompts.prompt: Build a Dwarf-Fortress-style ASCII colony simulator as a multi-file web game. An embark map of procedurally generated terrain (soil, stone layers, an underground cavern, trees, water) rendered as a coloured ASCII/glyph grid with MULTIPLE Z-LEVELS you page up and down through. Seven starting dwarves, each an autonomous agent with named skills, a job priority list, and needs (hunger, thirst, sleep, happiness). The player never controls dwarves directly — you place DESIGNATIONS and orders: mine/dig tiles, chop trees, build workshops, place stockpiles, and queue crafting jobs. Dwarves then pick jobs from the queue, path to them (A* across z-levels via stairs/ramps), haul goods to stockpiles, eat, drink and sleep. Time passes in seasons with a pause/speed control. Food and booze run down; unmet needs tank a dwarf's mood and can trigger a tantrum. A wildlife/goblin threat arrives after a while so walls and a drawbridge matter. Include a units list, a tile-inspection panel and an event log — the log narrating small disasters IS the game.
prompts.watchFor: Directly controlling dwarves instead of a designation + job-queue system; single z-level; pathfinding that ignores stairs; dwarves with no needs or moods; no stockpile hauling; no event log; simulation that stalls once the initial designations are done.

prompts.title: Slay the Spire
prompts.prompt: Build a Slay-the-Spire-style deckbuilding roguelike as a multi-file web game. A branching MAP of nodes (normal fights, elites, shops, rest sites, unknown events, a boss at the top) where you pick a path upward. Turn-based card combat: 3 ENERGY per turn, a draw pile / hand / discard pile that shuffles correctly, attack and skill cards, BLOCK that expires at the start of your turn, and enemy INTENTS shown above each enemy so you can plan (attack with damage number, block, buff, debuff). Status effects that stack and tick: vulnerable, weak, strength, poison. After a win, choose 1 of 3 card rewards; relics give passive rule-changing effects; a shop spends gold on cards/relics/removal; rest sites heal or upgrade a card. Two playable characters with distinct starter decks and card pools, an elite with a real gimmick, and a multi-phase boss. Persist the run so a refresh doesn't lose it, and show the full deck at any time.
prompts.watchFor: Random encounter order instead of a branching map; no energy limit (play every card); block persisting between turns; enemy intents hidden so combat is guesswork; draw/discard/shuffle mishandled (cards duplicated or lost); card rewards not actually entering the deck; relics that do nothing mechanical; no boss phases.

prompts.title: Cult of the Lamb
prompts.prompt: Build a Cult of the Lamb-style TWO-MODE game as a multi-file web game — the loop between the modes is the point. CRUSADE mode: a short roguelite dungeon run of cleared rooms with melee combat, a randomly assigned weapon (dagger/axe/sword/hammer, each with different speed and reach) and a curse/spell, dodge-roll, room-reward choices, a boss at the end, and resources (wood, stone, food, gold, devotion) carried home. CULT mode: a base you build and manage — recruit rescued FOLLOWERS who each have a name, faith, hunger and loyalty; build shrines, kitchens, farms, beds and outhouses; cook food (bad ingredients make them sick); preach a daily SERMON that converts faith into devotion, which unlocks doctrine choices; run RITUALS (feasts, funerals, sacrifices) that trade faith for power. Followers age, get sick, die, and can start DISSENT if faith drops — you can indoctrinate or sacrifice them. A day/night cycle drives the schedule, and dying on a crusade costs faith back home. Persist the cult between runs.
prompts.watchFor: Only one of the two modes implemented; crusade resources not feeding into base building; followers as anonymous counters instead of named agents with needs; faith/devotion with no consequences (no dissent); no day cycle or sermon rhythm; base state not persisted across runs.

prompts.title: Enter the Gungeon
prompts.prompt: Build an Enter the Gungeon-style twin-stick bullet-hell dungeon crawler as a multi-file web game. WASD to move, aim and fire with the mouse, and a DODGE ROLL that grants invulnerability frames and passes over bullets (with a recovery window so it isn't spammable) — the roll is the heart of the feel. Procedurally generated floors: a graph of rooms joined by corridors, sealed on entry until every enemy is dead, plus a shop room, a chest/treasure room and a boss room. Enemies fire readable, slow-ish bullet patterns (spreads, spirals, tracking shots) and different archetypes rush, snipe or shield. Guns are the loot: at least 8 with genuinely different feel (fire rate, spread, reload, projectile behaviour), finite ammo, an active reload, and pickups/chests that grant them. BLANKS clear all bullets on screen; tables can be flipped for temporary cover. Hearts/armour, keys for chests, a currency for the shop, a minimap, and a multi-phase boss with a telegraphed pattern cycle. Hundreds of bullets must stay smooth.
prompts.watchFor: Dodge roll with no i-frames or no cooldown; rooms not sealing so fights don't resolve; hand-built single floor instead of procedural rooms; guns that are palette swaps with identical stats; unavoidable/instant bullets (no telegraphs, too fast); no boss phases; perf collapse with many projectiles.

prompts.title: Balatro
prompts.prompt: Build a Balatro-style poker roguelite as a multi-file web game. Each ANTE has three BLINDS (small, big, then a boss blind with a rule-breaking gimmick) and a chip target. From a 52-card deck you draw 8 cards, select up to 5 to play as a poker hand, and may discard a limited number per blind. Scoring is the whole game and must be shown step by step: the hand type gives base CHIPS × MULT, each scoring card adds its chip value, then JOKERS trigger in left-to-right order to add chips, add mult or MULTIPLY mult — the ×mult jokers are what make runs explode. Implement correct poker hand detection (high card up to straight flush, including five-of-a-kind style hands if enhanced cards allow). Between blinds a SHOP sells jokers, vouchers, and booster packs; planet cards level up a hand type's base chips/mult permanently, tarot cards enhance individual cards (bonus/mult/glass/steel/wild), and hand size/discards can be upgraded. At least 20 jokers with distinct, readable conditional effects, joker reorder by drag, a run-info panel showing hand levels, and a satisfying score-count animation. Lose when you miss a blind's target; persist the run.
prompts.watchFor: Scoring collapsed into one number instead of the chips × mult pipeline; joker order not mattering; +mult and ×mult treated the same; incorrect or incomplete poker hand detection; no boss-blind gimmicks; shop/planet/tarot economy missing so runs can't scale; discards unlimited.

prompts.title: Space Invaders
prompts.prompt: Build Space Invaders as a multi-file web game. Five rows of invaders march sideways as one formation, reverse and descend at each edge, accelerate as their numbers fall, and fire downward from eligible columns. The player's cannon moves along the bottom behind four destructible shields whose pixels are eroded by either side's shots. Include the mystery UFO, score, lives, wave progression, game over, restart, keyboard controls, and simple arcade sound effects.
prompts.watchFor: Invaders moving independently instead of as a formation; no speed-up as enemies die; shields not destructible; shots passing through shields; no descending-loss condition.

prompts.title: Super Breakout
prompts.prompt: Build Super Breakout as a multi-file web game with responsive mouse and keyboard paddle control, convincing ball reflection based on impact position and paddle motion, score, serves, lives and increasing speed. Include its three selectable variants: Double with two balls and paddles, Cavity with trapped extra balls released from brick pockets, and Progressive with descending brick walls that regenerate. Add a title/mode screen, pause, game over and restart.
prompts.watchFor: Only ordinary Breakout implemented; missing Double/Cavity/Progressive modes; fixed-angle bounces; balls tunnelling through bricks; progressive wall never descending.

prompts.title: Asteroids
prompts.prompt: Build Asteroids as a multi-file web game with crisp vector-style rendering. The ship rotates, thrusts with inertia, fires with a limited number of live shots, and wraps at every screen edge. Large irregular asteroids split into two medium then two small fragments with inherited momentum; flying saucers enter and shoot at the player. Include risky hyperspace, score, extra lives, escalating waves, explosions, game over and restart.
prompts.watchFor: No inertia; objects bouncing instead of wrapping; asteroids disappearing rather than splitting twice; identical fragment trajectories; no saucers or hyperspace risk.

prompts.title: Galaxian
prompts.prompt: Build Galaxian as a multi-file web game. A colourful alien fleet sways in formation while individual enemies peel away on curved dive-bombing paths, fire during dives, and return to formation if they miss. Flagships should attack with red escorts for a formation bonus, and the player may have only one shot in flight, rewarding accuracy. Include score, lives, successive faster waves, starfield, game over and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Static enemies with no curved dives; divers never returning to formation; no flagship escort bonus; unlimited rapid fire; every enemy using the same attack path.

prompts.title: Lunar Lander
prompts.prompt: Build Lunar Lander as a multi-file web game with vector-style terrain and physically coherent gravity, rotation and variable main thrust. Fuel drains in proportion to thrust and cannot be replenished during a run. The camera zooms near the surface; narrow marked pads award larger multipliers, while landing safely requires both low vertical speed and a modest tilt. Show fuel, velocity, altitude, score, landing/crash feedback, multiple terrains and restart controls.
prompts.watchFor: Binary or cosmetic thrust; fuel not consumed; any terrain contact counting as a landing; tilt and velocity ignored; no reward difference between wide and narrow pads.

prompts.title: Armor Attack
prompts.prompt: Build Armor Attack as a multi-file web game with a monochrome vector look over a fixed ruined-town street maze. Drive a freely turning jeep with rotate, thrust and forward rockets, limited to two shots in flight. Enemy tanks follow streets, aim independent turrets, and take two hits—the first immobilizes the hull but leaves the turret dangerous. A helicopter loops over buildings and fires; destroying it spirals it down and can award a life. Include rising pace, score, lives and optional local two-player co-op.
prompts.watchFor: Tank hulls and turrets acting as one; tanks dying in one hit; helicopter blocked by buildings; jeep using four-way grid movement; no two-shot limit.

prompts.title: Battle Zone
prompts.prompt: Build Battle Zone as a multi-file web game using a true first-person 3D wireframe battlefield rendered with Canvas or WebGL. Simulate twin-tread tank steering, forward/reverse motion and a slow cannon with a reload delay. Enemy tanks manoeuvre and shoot, super-tanks are faster, missiles approach with warning audio, and radar shows nearby threats. Add wireframe mountains and obstacles, periscope-style HUD, score, lives, difficulty escalation and restart.
prompts.watchFor: Flat top-down gameplay; fake sprite scaling instead of 3D projection; no twin-tread steering; radar not matching world positions; cannon firing without reload timing.

prompts.title: Berzerk
prompts.prompt: Build Berzerk as a multi-file web game. Generate connected single-screen electrified mazes filled with armed robots; the player moves and fires in eight directions, and both touching walls and enemy shots are lethal. Robots track the player but can collide with walls, shots and one another. Exiting any open doorway advances immediately, while lingering summons the invincible bouncing Evil Otto. Include score, lives, increasing robot speed/fire, speech-like cues and restart.
prompts.watchFor: Safe wall contact; robots immune to their own hazards; rooms not connected through exits; Evil Otto absent or killable; movement restricted to four directions.

prompts.title: Centipede
prompts.prompt: Build Centipede as a multi-file web game with mouse/keyboard movement inside the lower player zone. A segmented centipede snakes horizontally through a mushroom field, drops a row and reverses whenever it hits a mushroom or edge; shooting a middle segment splits it into independent heads and leaves a mushroom. Add spiders weaving through the player area, fleas dropping mushrooms, scorpions poisoning mushrooms, poisoned dives, mushroom repair between waves, score, lives and escalating waves.
prompts.watchFor: Centipede treated as one health bar; no segment splitting; mushrooms not changing its route; missing spider/flea/scorpion behaviours; player free to move over the whole screen.

prompts.title: Crazy Climber
prompts.prompt: Build Crazy Climber as a multi-file web game. Climb a scrolling skyscraper by independently controlling left and right hands: reach for open window ledges, establish a grip, then pull the body upward; lateral movement requires alternating holds. Residents close windows and drop pots, signs and girders fall, birds attack, and a giant ape punches at the climber. Include falling after lost grips, checkpoints/floors, score, lives, rooftop rescue and keyboard controls that preserve the two-hand rhythm.
prompts.watchFor: Ordinary platformer controls instead of independent grips; closed windows still grabbable; hazards purely cosmetic; no fall state; building not scrolling upward.

prompts.title: Defender
prompts.prompt: Build Defender as a multi-file web game with fast bidirectional scrolling over a wrapping planet and a full-width scanner radar. Protect humanoids from landers that descend, abduct them and mutate if they reach the top; shoot an abductor and catch the falling human, then return them safely to the ground. Give the ship thrust, reverse, rapid laser, limited smart bombs and hyperspace. Add distinct enemy types, planet-destruction consequence if every human is lost, score, lives, waves and responsive keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: One-way scrolling; radar not representing off-screen threats; abductions have no mutation consequence; falling humans cannot be caught; no reverse/smart bomb/hyperspace.

prompts.title: Missile Command
prompts.prompt: Build Missile Command as a multi-file web game using mouse aim. Defend six cities and three missile bases from branching incoming warheads, bombers and satellites. Each base has its own finite ammunition and firing from it launches a visible interceptor toward the cursor; detonation creates a slowly expanding then shrinking blast chain that can ignite multiple threats. Surviving cities persist between waves, remaining missiles and cities earn bonuses, destroyed bases reload next wave, and the game ends when all cities are gone.
prompts.watchFor: Instant hitscan explosions; no travel time or expanding blast radius; shared unlimited ammo; chain reactions missing; cities automatically restored every wave.

prompts.title: Moon Cresta
prompts.prompt: Build Moon Cresta as a multi-file web game. Start with the small first-stage ship and fight distinct alien waves; after several waves attempt a manual docking sequence with the next ship section by matching horizontal position and orientation while descending. Successful docks create a larger, more powerful craft with multiple firing points, but expose more collision area; losing a section continues with the next available stage. Include three sections, docking bonuses, wave cycle, score, lives and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Ships combining automatically; docking has no alignment challenge; combined craft not changing firepower or hitbox; loss always resetting to stage one; identical enemy waves.

prompts.title: Phoenix
prompts.prompt: Build Phoenix as a multi-file web game with a five-wave loop: two formations of small birds, two waves of large phoenixes that hatch, swoop and regenerate damaged wings, then a mothership boss. The player's horizontal ship fires upward and can activate a brief shield that blocks attacks but also prevents firing and must recharge. Defeat the mothership by breaking through its moving hull barrier and hitting the protected pilot. Include score, lives, escalating loops and arcade audio.
prompts.watchFor: All five waves reduced to one enemy type; shield usable continuously or while firing; phoenix wings not destructible/regenerative; mothership lacking layered defences and a pilot weak point.

prompts.title: Rally X
prompts.prompt: Build Rally-X as a multi-file web game. Drive continuously through a scrolling maze to collect every flag while a separate radar shows flags and pursuing red cars beyond the viewport. Steering happens at junctions; fuel drains over time and faster during acceleration. Drop limited smoke screens that stun pursuers but consume fuel, avoid rocks and head-on collisions, and award a bonus for the special flag. Include increasingly dense stages, score, fuel, lives and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Whole maze shown at once; radar absent or inaccurate; car can stop freely; smoke has no fuel cost/stun effect; enemy cars wander instead of pursuing.

prompts.title: Star Castle
prompts.prompt: Build Star Castle as a multi-file web game with vector-style wraparound space physics. A central cannon is protected by three independently rotating rings of shield segments; shots break segments, but opening a line to the core lets the cannon aim and fire back. The core launches homing mines, and surviving ring segments gradually rebuild unless pressured. Give the player rotation, thrust and fire, plus score, lives, increasingly fast castles and restart.
prompts.watchFor: Shield rings static; core vulnerable through intact segments; no dangerous return-fire lane when a gap opens; shields never regenerate; no homing mines or inertia.

prompts.title: Tempest
prompts.prompt: Build Tempest as a multi-file web game with bright vector rendering on multiple geometric tube webs. The claw moves around the near rim using mouse, wheel or keyboard and fires down the current lane at flippers, tankers, spikers and fuseballs climbing toward it. Enemies reaching the rim pursue across lanes. A limited Superzapper clears the web once and weakens enemies a second time; clearing a web triggers a high-speed flight through the tube while avoiding spikes. Include level selection, score, lives and escalating web shapes.
prompts.watchFor: Flat fixed-shooter presentation; no lane-based tube projection; enemy types behaving identically; Superzapper unlimited; no between-level spike flight.

prompts.title: Warlords
prompts.prompt: Build Warlords as a multi-file web game for one to four local players, filling empty seats with AI. Each corner contains a king behind a destructible brick castle wall and a shield paddle that rotates around the corner. Deflect the shared fireball into opponents' walls; holding the catch control briefly traps the ball so it can be aimed and released, but lingering is risky. Eliminate a player when the king is struck and continue until one remains. Support keyboard/gamepad, rounds, wins and accelerating ricochets.
prompts.watchFor: Only two players; paddles sliding on straight lines; no catch-and-aim mechanic; castle bricks not individually destructible; eliminated corners still acting normally.

prompts.title: Wizard of Wor
prompts.prompt: Build Wizard of Wor as a multi-file web game with solo and simultaneous two-player co-op. Warriors explore single-screen mazes, fire down corridors and can accidentally shoot each other. Burwors roam visibly, Garwors and Thorwors turn invisible except on the bottom radar, and clearing them summons the fast Worluk before the Wizard can appear and teleport. Include maze-to-maze progression, dungeon difficulty tiers, score/lives per player, bonus lives for killing the Worluk and keyboard/gamepad controls.
prompts.watchFor: Invisible enemies also disappearing from radar; no friendly fire; Wizard not teleporting; maze doors/corridors ignored by AI; missing Worluk bonus phase.

prompts.title: Amidar
prompts.prompt: Build Amidar as a multi-file web game. Move along a rectilinear grid while enemies follow deterministic intersection rules; traversing every edge around a box fills and scores it. Alternate paint-roller stages, where completed boxes must spread from painted territory, with gorilla/coconut stages. Give the player only three limited jumps per life to pass through enemies, and award a temporary invincibility bonus when all four corner boxes are filled. Include score, lives and faster layouts.
prompts.watchFor: Free movement off the grid; boxes filling before every edge is traced; enemies using simple direct chase instead of intersection patterns; unlimited jumps; no alternating stage rules.

prompts.title: Bosconian
prompts.prompt: Build Bosconian as a multi-file web game. Fly freely in eight directions through a scrolling starfield while the ship remains near centre and fires forward and backward simultaneously. Use a radar to locate every hexagonal base; destroy one by hitting its central core in an opening or by clearing all six outer cannons for a bonus. Add enemy formations, missiles, mines, escalating condition alerts, score, lives and rounds with increasing base counts.
prompts.watchFor: No rear shot; radar not tied to world positions; bases as one-hit sprites; no choice between core shot and six-cannon clear; fixed-screen instead of open scrolling space.

prompts.title: Gorf
prompts.prompt: Build Gorf as a multi-file web game whose identity is five distinct missions: shielded Astro Battles, a Laser Attack duel, a diving Galaxian-style formation, a Space Warp tunnel, and a Flag Ship battle where shots chip the hull until the reactor is exposed. Let the player's ship move freely around the lower third and cancel its previous shot by firing again. Completing all five raises rank and loops at higher difficulty. Include voice-like taunts, score, lives and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Five missions collapsed into repeated waves; ship limited to horizontal movement; no shot replacement; flagship destroyed by generic health damage instead of an exposed reactor; no rank loop.

prompts.title: Mousetrap
prompts.prompt: Build Mouse Trap as a multi-file web maze game. Guide a mouse through dots and cheese while cats hunt it, and use separate red, yellow and blue controls to rotate matching doors throughout the maze and redirect traffic. Collect dog bones, then spend one to transform briefly into a dog that can chase and eat cats; reach the central IN box to release a hawk that targets the mouse. Add bonus items, score, lives, new mazes, faster enemies and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Coloured door buttons not independently changing routes; dog form free or permanent; cats edible as an ordinary mouse; no hawk/IN-box risk; maze AI walking through closed doors.

prompts.title: Ms. Pac-Man
prompts.prompt: Build Ms. Pac-Man as a multi-file web game with four distinct mazes that rotate through levels, dots, power pellets, side tunnels and smooth grid-aligned movement. Implement four ghosts with distinct targeting and scatter behaviour, frightened timing and eyes returning to the pen. Fruit should move through each maze along entry and exit paths rather than sitting still. Include score, lives, escalating speed/timing, intermission-style transitions, game over and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Merely reskinning one Pac-Man maze; fruit stationary; ghosts sharing identical chase logic; frightened mode never expiring; tunnel and pen pathfinding broken.

prompts.title: Omega Race
prompts.prompt: Build Omega Race as a multi-file web game with glowing vector graphics. Rotate, thrust and fire an inertial fighter around a rectangular raceway with a central obstacle; the outer force field and barriers bounce the ship elastically. Clear droid ships, aggressively shooting command ships and their photon mines before commanders transform into extremely fast death ships. Limit simultaneous shots, carry leftover mines between waves, and include score, lives, rising tempo and restart.
prompts.watchFor: Walls killing or stopping the player instead of bouncing; no inertial thrust; command ships never laying mines or transforming; mines wiped between waves; unlimited shots.

prompts.title: Qix
prompts.prompt: Build Qix as a multi-file web game. Move safely along the boundary of an empty field, then hold Slow Draw or Fast Draw to venture out and create a line; reconnect to a claimed edge to fill the side not containing the roaming Qix. Sparx patrol existing boundaries and fuse-like enemies chase an unfinished draw line if the player pauses. Require a target percentage to advance, reward risky fast-draw areas more, support splitting two Qix for a multiplier, and include score, lives and escalating levels.
prompts.watchFor: Area fill choosing the wrong side; Qix crossing finished walls; no vulnerability while drawing; Sparx unable to follow new boundaries; fast and slow draw scoring identically.

prompts.title: Satan's Hollow
prompts.prompt: Build Satan's Hollow as a multi-file web game. Move a cannon along the bottom, shoot patterned gargoyle waves and use a short-duration shield that destroys touching enemies but must recharge. Kills produce bridge pieces that the player must physically collect and carry to build a bridge across the lava; enemy rocks can break placed sections. Cross only when complete to duel Satan, then earn an upgraded gun and build a longer bridge next cycle. Include ship-stealing enemies, score, lives and escalating waves.
prompts.watchFor: Bridge filling automatically from kills; pieces not carried; shield unlimited or instant-recharging; rocks unable to damage the bridge; Satan fight disconnected from bridge completion.

prompts.title: Stargate
prompts.prompt: Build Stargate (Defender II) as a multi-file web game with fast bidirectional wraparound scrolling and a scanner radar. Protect humanoids from abduction, catch falling people and use thrust, reverse, laser, smart bombs, hyperspace and a limited cloaking shield. Add the stargate itself: entering it while a humanoid is in danger warps to that rescue, while other conditions grant tactical skips or bonuses. Include new enemy types such as firebombers and yllabian space guppies, score, lives and escalating waves.
prompts.watchFor: Just Defender with no functional stargate; no cloak meter; stargate warps random rather than responding to game state; radar/abduction loop missing; one-way scrolling.

prompts.title: Turbo
prompts.prompt: Build Turbo as a multi-file web pseudo-3D racing game using projected road segments and sprite scaling. Steer and accelerate through city streets, country roads, snow and tunnels while overtaking a quota of rival cars before the timer expires. Road bends, crests and traffic should affect visibility; collisions slow the car rather than simply ending the run. Include gear-like acceleration, speedometer, rank/overtake counter, checkpoint extensions, changing scenery and keyboard/gamepad controls.
prompts.watchFor: Top-down road instead of pseudo-3D projection; no traffic depth scaling; timer not tied to an overtake quota; collisions have no speed penalty; scenery never changes.

prompts.title: Vanguard
prompts.prompt: Build Vanguard as a multi-file web game through several named cave zones with horizontal, diagonal and finally vertical scrolling. Let the ship move freely and fire independently left, right, up and down to handle threats on every side. Terrain collision is lethal except while an energy pod grants temporary invulnerability and ramming power. Give each zone distinct enemy formations and cave shapes, finish with the vertical City of Mystery and Gond boss, and include fuel/energy, score, lives and zone transitions.
prompts.watchFor: One scrolling direction for every zone; only forward fire; energy pod not enabling safe ramming; cave walls non-colliding; no vertical final zone or Gond battle.

prompts.title: Bagman
prompts.prompt: Build Bagman as a multi-file web game across three connected mine screens. Run, climb ladders, ride lifts and hang from ceiling bars while retrieving every money bag and carrying it one at a time to the surface wheelbarrow. Bags slow the player and can be dropped or thrown; pickaxes briefly knock out pursuing guards, and mine carts can carry bags or run characters over. Include guard pathfinding across screens, score, lives, a round timer, rising difficulty and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Bags collected on touch instead of carried; no movement penalty while carrying; guards unable to use ladders/lifts; pickaxes permanent weapons; screens not connected.

prompts.title: Black Widow
prompts.prompt: Build Black Widow as a multi-file web twin-stick shooter with neon vector styling. Move a spider around an irregular web while aiming and firing independently with mouse or keys. Distinct bugs enter along web strands: some lay eggs that hatch if ignored, some push dangerous grenades, and some leave Grubsteaks that must be collected before the rival Bug Slayer steals them. Clear each web, preserve web-constrained movement and enemy routing, and include score, lives and escalating waves.
prompts.watchFor: Aim locked to movement; free movement off web strands; eggs never hatching; all bugs behaving as simple chasers; Grubsteaks and Bug Slayer absent.

prompts.title: Bubbles
prompts.prompt: Build Bubbles as a multi-file web game set in a top-down kitchen sink. Control a soap bubble with smooth acceleration, drift and damping while scrubbing ants, crumbs and grease. Cleaning makes the bubble grow from vulnerable to smiling and able to bump brushes and sponges, though razor blades remain deadly; contact with threats can shrink it again. When enough dirt is cleared the drain flashes and becomes the exit. Add roaches, the cleaning lady/broom bonus, score, lives and harder sinks.
prompts.watchFor: Instant grid movement instead of slippery drift; bubble size purely cosmetic; every enemy always lethal; drain open from the start; cleaning progress not tied to growth.

prompts.title: Bump 'n' Jump
prompts.prompt: Build Bump 'n' Jump as a multi-file web vertically scrolling combat racer. Steer and accelerate while bumping rival cars sideways into walls or one another, but avoid being rammed off the road. Use a limited-height jump to clear water, broken bridges, rocks and traffic, with a visible shadow and committed airborne trajectory. Vary road width and terrain, spawn distinct enemy vehicles, award a no-car-destroyed bonus, and include fuel/time pressure, score, lives and stage progression.
prompts.watchFor: Jump as invulnerability with no airborne trajectory; rivals unaffected by side impacts; no gaps requiring jumps; car locked to lanes; road never changing width.

prompts.title: Burger Time
prompts.prompt: Build BurgerTime as a multi-file web game. Chef Peter Pepper runs across platforms and ladders; walking over every segment of a giant ingredient makes it fall one level, and dropping it onto another ingredient cascades the stack toward its plate. Hot dogs, eggs and pickles pursue through the maze and can be crushed by falling food or shaken off by a drop. Limited pepper stuns enemies. Complete every burger to advance, with score, lives and increasingly complex layouts.
prompts.watchFor: Ingredients dropping after one touch instead of every segment; no cascade/crush logic; enemies unable to use ladders; unlimited pepper; level ending before burgers reach plates.

prompts.title: Dig Dug
prompts.prompt: Build Dig Dug as a multi-file web game. Dig permanent tunnels through layered soil while Pookas and fire-breathing Fygars pursue through tunnels or temporarily become ghostly eyes that pass through dirt. Fire a pump hose in four directions; repeated pumps inflate an enemy until it bursts, but stopping lets it recover. Undermine rocks so they wobble then fall, crushing enemies for combos. The last enemy should flee toward the surface. Include vegetables, score, lives and harder rounds.
prompts.watchFor: Prebuilt maze instead of diggable soil; enemies unable to ghost through dirt; one-hit pump kills; rocks falling without being undermined/warning; Fygar lacking horizontal fire.

prompts.title: Donkey Kong Junior
prompts.prompt: Build Donkey Kong Jr. as a multi-file web game with four distinct stages culminating in the key cage. Junior runs, jumps and climbs vines/chains; gripping two vines climbs faster while descending is slower, and fruit can be dropped onto enemies. Add red and blue Snapjaws, Nitpickers and Sparks with stage-specific movement. In the final stage, push six keys upward along chains into locks while avoiding enemies to free Donkey Kong. Include score, lives, bonus timer and stage loops.
prompts.watchFor: Generic ladder climbing; no two-vine speed difference; fruit collected instead of dropped as a weapon; four stages missing; final keys not physically moved to locks.

prompts.title: Food Fight
prompts.prompt: Build Food Fight as a multi-file web game. Move freely through obstacle-filled single-screen arenas and reach an ice-cream cone before it melts. Aim and throw pies, tomatoes, bananas and other food at chefs; projectiles have limited range or distinct arcs and leave splats, while chefs emerge from manholes and pursue around obstacles. Occasional instant-use power foods should clear crowds. Include melting timer, bonus based on remaining ice cream, score, lives, varied layouts and keyboard/mouse controls.
prompts.watchFor: Ice cream not visibly melting; food as unlimited identical bullets; chefs ignoring obstacles; no manhole spawning; touching the goal always awarding the same bonus.

prompts.title: Gravitar
prompts.prompt: Build Gravitar as a multi-file web game with vector graphics and persistent Newtonian thrust. Navigate a solar-system map, enter planets, then fly through scrolling caverns where gravity pulls toward the terrain. Rotate, thrust, fire and use a shield while destroying hostile bunkers; use a tractor beam to collect finite fuel cells without crashing. Clear every planet to reach a reactor mission that must be escaped before detonation. Include fuel, shields, score, lives and increasingly hostile systems.
prompts.watchFor: No gravity/inertia; planetary stages as flat arenas; fuel unlimited; tractor beam missing; terrain collision forgiving enough to erase the landing challenge; no reactor escape.

prompts.title: Joust
prompts.prompt: Build Joust as a multi-file web game with single-player and simultaneous local co-op. Tap flap to lift an ostrich while gravity and horizontal momentum create weighty aerial control. Collisions are decided by lance height: the higher rider wins, turning the loser into an egg that must be collected before it hatches into a stronger knight. Add platform landings, lava and its hand, pterodactyl pressure for stalling, distinct enemy rider tiers, score, lives and escalating waves.
prompts.watchFor: Continuous free flight instead of flap physics; collisions decided by generic damage; no eggs/hatching; identical enemy tiers; lava and pterodactyl pressure absent.

prompts.title: Jungle King
prompts.prompt: Build Jungle King as a multi-file web game with four mechanically distinct timed stages: swing between vines and release with inherited momentum; swim through a river while managing an air meter and knifing crocodiles only when their mouths are shut; run uphill while jumping or ducking rolling boulders; then leap over cannibals and reach the captive. Include precise animation cues, score, lives, remaining-time bonus and faster loops after a rescue.
prompts.watchFor: Four stages reduced to one platformer; vine releases ignoring swing momentum; no air meter; crocodile mouth state irrelevant; rescue stage lacking timed jumps.

prompts.title: Millipede
prompts.prompt: Build Millipede as a multi-file web game with fast mouse/keyboard movement in the lower zone. A segmented millipede routes around mushrooms and splits when shot, joined by spiders, beetles, mosquitoes, inchworms, bees, dragonflies and earwigs with distinct effects on speed or mushroom placement. Include scorpions poisoning mushrooms and a rare DDT bomb whose expanding cloud destroys chains of nearby creatures. Add score, lives, mushroom repair and steadily denser waves.
prompts.watchFor: Merely reskinning Centipede with no expanded insect roster; DDT acting as an ordinary shot; no segment splitting; insects not affecting mushrooms or tempo; player leaving lower zone.

prompts.title: Moon Patrol
prompts.prompt: Build Moon Patrol as a multi-file web game with layered parallax lunar scenery. The rover auto-drives but can accelerate, brake and jump with a readable arc while firing forward at rocks and upward at UFOs. Craters and mines require timed jumps, UFO bombs can create new craters, and checkpoint letters divide the course into timed sections. Add distinct beginner/champion courses, checkpoint time bonuses, score, lives, increasing combinations of ground and air threats, and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: No parallax; jump height/arc not affected by timing; one weapon direction; UFO bombs unable to alter ground danger; no checkpoint timing or course progression.

prompts.title: Pengo
prompts.prompt: Build Pengo as a multi-file web game. Push ice blocks along clear rows until they hit a wall/block, crushing Sno-Bees in their path; blocks can also be shattered, and Sno-Bees dig through ordinary ice while pursuing. Press against the outer wall to make it vibrate and briefly stun nearby enemies. Three indestructible diamond blocks earn a large bonus when aligned in a row with no gaps. Clear all Sno-Bees, show eggs hidden in ice, and include score, lives and increasingly aggressive rounds.
prompts.watchFor: Blocks moving one tile instead of sliding; enemies passing through ice without digging; wall stun missing; diamond alignment bonus accepting gaps; hidden eggs not spawning enemies.

prompts.title: Pole Position
prompts.prompt: Build Pole Position as a multi-file web pseudo-3D racer using projected road segments, hills, bends and sprite-scaled opponents. First complete a timed qualifying lap fast enough to earn a grid position; only then run the race, passing cars before checkpoint time expires. Provide steering, throttle, brake and low/high gear, with grass slowing the car and collisions causing a spin/explosion plus costly recovery. Include lap times, position, speedometer, roadside scenery and keyboard/gamepad controls.
prompts.watchFor: Top-down racing; no qualifying gate; road lacks hills/curves; low/high gear cosmetic; collisions reset instantly with no time loss; opponents not depth-scaled.

prompts.title: Popeye
prompts.prompt: Build Popeye as a multi-file web game across three distinct single-screen stages. Move on platforms, stairs and ladders while catching every heart, musical note or letter Olive drops before it sinks away. Brutus actively intercepts and attacks, the Sea Hag throws bouncing hazards, and Popeye can punch bottles but cannot normally punch Brutus. Each stage has one spinach can that temporarily grants the power to knock Brutus away for bonus points. Include stage-specific goals, score, lives and bonus timer.
prompts.watchFor: Generic brawler combat; collectibles waiting forever; spinach permanent or reusable; Brutus only patrolling; three stage layouts/goals missing.

prompts.title: Q*bert
prompts.prompt: Build Q*bert as a multi-file web game on an isometric pyramid. Diagonal controls hop between cube tops; each landing changes a cube's colour according to the current round rule, including later stages that require two hits or can be changed back. Coily hatches from a purple ball and hunts intelligently, while Ugg, Wrong-Way and Sam/Slick use their signature routes or undo colours. Side discs rescue Q*bert and lure Coily off the pyramid. Include score, lives and escalating rounds.
prompts.watchFor: Screen-direction controls not mapped to pyramid diagonals; cube states always one-hit; enemies sharing the same path rules; discs as ordinary teleporters with no Coily interaction; falling not lethal.

prompts.title: Quantum
prompts.prompt: Build Quantum as a multi-file web game with colourful vector graphics and direct mouse/trackball-style control of a fast probe. Destroy atomic particles by drawing a closed loop around them; capturing several in one loop multiplies the reward. The probe leaves a live trail and dies on contact with particles or its own unfinished line, so tight curves and route planning matter. Add distinct particle movement patterns, splitters and pulsars, level targets, score, lives and a drawable high-score signature screen.
prompts.watchFor: Click-to-select enemies instead of physically encircling them; open paths counting as captures; self-trail collision ignored; multi-capture has no multiplier; all particles moving alike.

prompts.title: Robotron: 2084
prompts.prompt: Build Robotron: 2084 as a multi-file web twin-stick arena shooter. Movement and eight-direction firing are independent, with dense enemy waves and instant, readable collisions. Grunts swarm directly; Hulks are indestructible and convert or kill the last human family; Enforcers fire angled shots; Brains transform humans into Progs; Tanks bounce projectiles; Spheroids and Quarks spawn more threats. Rescue Mom, Dad and Mikey for escalating family bonuses. Include score, lives, wave transitions and performance suitable for hundreds of entities.
prompts.watchFor: Aim locked to movement; all enemies simple chasers; Hulks killable; humans merely decorative; no family-rescue scoring chain; frame rate collapsing in dense waves.

prompts.title: Sinistar
prompts.prompt: Build Sinistar as a multi-file web game in a scrolling asteroid field with a radar. Mine drifting planetoids by shooting them, race worker ships to collect the released crystals, and convert crystals into a limited stock of Sinibombs. Meanwhile workers assemble Sinistar piece by piece; when complete he hunts the player and can only be damaged by Sinibombs, requiring thirteen hits. Add warrior ships, four escalating zones, positional audio/voice warnings, score, lives and responsive eight-direction movement.
prompts.watchFor: Crystals granted automatically; enemy workers not competing for resources/building Sinistar; ordinary lasers damaging the boss; no bomb inventory; radar not showing off-screen danger.

prompts.title: Space Duel
prompts.prompt: Build Space Duel as a multi-file web vector shooter with inertia, rotation, thrust, fire and a limited rechargeable shield. Offer solo single-ship, solo tethered-pair, two-player independent and two-player tethered modes. In tethered play the ships pull and orbit one another, produce two firing origins, and a hit may burn along the link toward the survivor. Fight colourful geometric enemies that split or behave differently across waves. Include local controls, score, lives and escalating rounds.
prompts.watchFor: Tether rendered cosmetically with no coupled physics; missing four play configurations; shield unlimited; no fuse-like link damage; enemies just monochrome asteroid clones.

prompts.title: Star Trek
prompts.prompt: Build Sega's Star Trek arcade game as a multi-file web vector-style space combat game. Present a first-person tactical view plus a strategic sector map: warp between sectors, manoeuvre with impulse, destroy Klingon ships with phasers and finite photon torpedoes, and protect starbases. Shields absorb hits by draining shared energy; movement and weapons also consume energy, so dock with a surviving starbase to repair and resupply. Add antimatter-saucer hazards, score, timed sector objectives, increasing waves and keyboard controls.
prompts.watchFor: Only an arcade shooting screen with no sector map; energy not shared by systems; starbases impossible to dock with or defend; phasers and torpedoes identical; no warp travel.

prompts.title: Time Pilot
prompts.prompt: Build Time Pilot as a multi-file web game. Keep the player's aircraft centred while the cloud field and enemies scroll freely in every direction; rotate continuously, fly forward and fire. Clear waves set in 1910, 1940, 1970, 1982 and 2001, each with era-specific enemies and attacks, then defeat that era's larger command craft to time-warp onward. Add parachutists to rescue, enemy formations entering from off-screen, score, lives and increasing speed after the timeline loops.
prompts.watchFor: Fixed-screen or vertical-only scrolling; plane able to stop/reverse like a cursor; historical eras only visual reskins; no command craft gate; rescued parachutists absent.

prompts.title: Tron
prompts.prompt: Build Tron as a multi-file web game containing all four selectable arcade challenges, with difficulty colours advancing after the set is cleared: Light Cycles, where players leave solid trails and trap AI riders; MCP Cone, breaking through rotating blocks to enter the cone; Battle Tanks, navigating a maze with independent turret aim and ricocheting shots; and I/O Tower, fighting grid bugs then entering the beam before its timer closes. Use mode-appropriate controls, score, lives and neon presentation.
prompts.watchFor: Only Light Cycles implemented; four challenges not selectable; tank turret locked to movement; MCP blocks/cone timing absent; I/O beam never closing.

prompts.title: Tutankham
prompts.prompt: Build Tutankham as a multi-file web game through scrolling tomb mazes. Explore in four directions but fire only horizontally, making vertical corridors dangerous. Find keys, carry them to matching locked doors, collect treasures and reach the exit before the timer expires while creatures continuously emerge from generators. Give the player one limited flash-bomb per life to clear the screen, plus destructible shortcuts where appropriate. Include four distinct chambers, score, lives, treasure bonuses and faster loops.
prompts.watchFor: Vertical shooting allowed; keys open every door regardless of match/order; maze shown as one fixed screen; generators stop producing threats; flash bomb unlimited.

prompts.title: Xevious
prompts.prompt: Build Xevious as a multi-file web vertical shooter over a continuously scrolling landscape. Use two genuinely separate weapons: a forward zapper for airborne enemies and a bomb dropped onto the moving ground reticle for tanks, domes and hidden targets. Script enemy formations and ground layouts, include reflective Bacura plates, concealed Sol towers revealed by bombing, the giant Andor Genesis fortress with destructible cores, score, lives and checkpoints after death.
prompts.watchFor: One weapon damages everything; bomb lands at ship rather than ground reticle; air/ground layers share collision; hidden targets absent; scenery and waves random instead of authored.

prompts.title: Zaxxon
prompts.prompt: Build Zaxxon as a multi-file web isometric scrolling shooter. Fly through fortress corridors with independent horizontal and altitude control; a shadow and altimeter must communicate height, shots travel at the current altitude, and walls, barriers and missiles require flying over or under them. Destroy fuel drums to replenish a steadily draining fuel gauge, alternate fortress and open-space sections, then fight the Zaxxon robot by hitting its missile. Include score, lives and escalating courses.
prompts.watchFor: Altitude only cosmetic; shadows not aligned with the ship; shots hitting targets at different heights; fuel drums not refilling fuel; flat top-down rendering; no robot weak-point fight.

prompts.title: Zoo Keeper
prompts.prompt: Build Zoo Keeper as a multi-file web game. In the main stage, run and jump around the outer ledges of an animal pen, placing wall bricks underfoot while escaped animals break the wall from inside; jump whole groups for multiplied scores and collect nets to recapture them. Interleave an escalator stage, dodging animals to reach the top, and a coconut stage where jumps knock coconuts onto an ape to rescue the keeper's partner. Include score, lives, bonus items and harder animal mixes.
prompts.watchFor: Wall built automatically; animals not breaking individual bricks; group-jump multiplier missing; only the pen stage implemented; net not changing capture behaviour.

prompts.title: Crossbow
prompts.prompt: Build Crossbow as a multi-file web light-gun game using mouse or pointer aim. A party of adventurers walks automatically across dangerous scenes while the player shoots arrows, fireballs, falling rocks, bats and other threats before they reach the group; friendly characters must never be valid targets. Let the player choose a route between locations, preserve surviving party members, and finish at a castle confrontation. Include limited shot cadence, destructible hazards, score, lives/survivors and escalating scenes.
prompts.watchFor: Player directly controlling the adventurers; escorts immune to hazards; no friendly-fire distinction; hitscan cursor with unlimited fire rate; route choice and survivor persistence missing.

prompts.title: Crystal Castles
prompts.prompt: Build Crystal Castles as a multi-file web game with fast mouse/keyboard movement around isometric 3D maze structures, ramps, lifts and tunnels. Bentley Bear must collect every gem while enemies also consume them, racing the player for score. Add gem eaters, skeletons, trees and Berthilda the witch; collect a magic hat for temporary invulnerability and bonus interactions. Include the last-gem bonus, hidden shortcuts/warps, score, lives and at least several distinct castles.
prompts.watchFor: Flat top-down maze; enemies not consuming gems; ramps/elevators lacking height-aware collision; magic hat just adding points; no last-gem race.

prompts.title: Discs of Tron
prompts.prompt: Build Discs of Tron as a multi-file web game in a behind-the-player pseudo-3D arena. Move between concentric platforms, aim horizontally and vertically, and throw up to three energy discs that ricochet from walls before returning. Defeat Sark by direct hits or destroying the platform beneath him while dodging, intercepting or briefly deflecting his discs. Add limited deflect uses, chaser projectiles, moving platforms, barriers with gaps, twelve escalating arena variations, score and lives.
prompts.watchFor: Flat side-view duel; discs vanish instead of bouncing/returning; no vertical aim; shield/deflect unlimited; platforms indestructible; later arena variations missing.

prompts.title: Dragon's Lair
prompts.prompt: Build a Dragon's Lair-style multi-file web game as an original animated interactive adventure. Create a branching sequence of at least twelve short scenes; each presents subtle visual danger cues and accepts one correctly timed direction or sword action. Correct input flows into a success animation and the next room, while wrong or late input plays a scene-specific failure and costs a life. Randomize several room branches, include mirrored/repeated variants with tighter timing, a final dragon rescue sequence, score, lives and an optional cue/tutorial mode.
prompts.watchFor: Static trivia buttons instead of timed scene input; prompts explicitly revealing every answer; one generic failure animation; no branching/random room order; final sequence absent.

prompts.title: Elevator Action
prompts.prompt: Build Elevator Action as a multi-file web game. Infiltrate at the roof and descend a scrolling building using elevators, escalators and corridors, entering every red door to steal secret documents before escaping in the basement car. Agents emerge from ordinary doors, crouch and fire; the spy can shoot, jump-kick, duck bullets, crush foes with elevators and drop ceiling lamps by shooting them. Include elevator call/motion logic, missed-document backtracking, score, lives and increasingly dangerous buildings.
prompts.watchFor: Red doors optional; elevators as simple teleporters; no vertical crush hazards; agents unable to use doors/elevators; reaching basement wins despite missing documents.

prompts.title: Gyruss
prompts.prompt: Build Gyruss as a multi-file web tube shooter. The ship orbits 360 degrees around the screen edge while facing into a starfield tunnel; enemies fly from the vanishing point along spirals, assemble briefly, then attack outward with depth-scaled shots. Script a journey from Neptune toward Earth with three warps per planet, formation bonuses, satellites that can grant dual fire, asteroid fields and a boss-like defence at Earth. Include score, lives and steadily faster approach patterns.
prompts.watchFor: Ordinary vertical shooter; player not orbiting the rim; enemies lacking depth scaling/spiral entry; no planet progression; dual-fire satellite pickup absent.

prompts.title: M.A.C.H. 3
prompts.prompt: Build an M.A.C.H. 3-inspired multi-file web rail shooter with original procedurally staged scenery rather than external video. Offer two distinct missions: a low-altitude fighter run that shoots aircraft and ground defences while dodging terrain, and a high-altitude bomber run that lines up a moving bombsight over ground targets while interceptors attack. Create a convincing forward rush with perspective scaling, horizon turns and landmark hazards. Include target quotas, fuel/damage, score, lives and keyboard/pointer controls.
prompts.watchFor: Two modes playing identically; flat scrolling background with no forward depth; bomber using the fighter gun instead of a bombsight; terrain collision missing; target quota not gating progress.

prompts.title: Major Havoc
prompts.prompt: Build Major Havoc as a multi-file web vector game with its full alternating loop. First fly a side-to-side space battle, breaking enemy shields and clearing defenders; then align with a moving landing corridor. Inside the station, run and jump through a low-gravity maze, collect oxygen, avoid robots, reach the reactor and arm it, then retrace the route and escape before the countdown detonates. Include a short Breakout-style warp mini-game, multiple harder station layouts, score, lives and clear phase transitions.
prompts.watchFor: Only shooter or platform phase implemented; docking automatic; no low-gravity movement/oxygen; reactor has no timed escape; route arrows and warp mini-game absent.

prompts.title: Mappy
prompts.prompt: Build Mappy as a multi-file web game in a multi-floor mansion. Mappy runs along floors and automatically bounces on trampolines between them; each trampoline weakens with consecutive bounces and eventually breaks unless he steps onto a floor. Collect matching stolen goods for increasing pair bonuses while cats pursue. Opening colour-coded doors emits a microwave pulse that sweeps enemies away, and bells can drop on them. Include Goro hiding behind goods, score, lives and increasingly complex mansions.
prompts.watchFor: Free vertical jumping instead of trampoline travel; trampoline durability ignored; goods have no pairing bonus; doors lack directional microwave force; cats unable to traverse floors.

prompts.title: Mario Brothers
prompts.prompt: Build the original Mario Bros. as a multi-file web game with solo and simultaneous two-player local play. Enemies emerge from upper pipes and traverse wraparound platforms; jump from below to flip a Shellcreeper or other enemy, then kick it before it recovers. Add Sidesteppers that require two bumps, Fighter Flies with hopping windows, Slipice that freezes platforms, fireballs and a limited POW block that bumps every floor. Include coins, score, lives, bonus phases and escalating waves.
prompts.watchFor: Stomping enemies from above; one hit directly kills instead of flip-then-kick; no screen wrap; POW unlimited; enemy types share identical recovery/movement.

prompts.title: Mr. Do!
prompts.prompt: Build Mr. Do! as a multi-file web game. Dig new paths through soil, collect cherries in groups of eight, and defeat pursuing monsters with a bouncing power ball that must return before it can be thrown again. Undermine apples so they drop and crush chains of enemies, but they can also crush the player. Support alternate clears by collecting all cherries, defeating every enemy, spelling EXTRA via special alpha monsters, or finding a diamond. Include score, lives and harder layouts.
prompts.watchFor: Prebuilt tunnels only; power ball available again before returning; apples harmless to player; only one level-clear route; alpha monsters/EXTRA system absent.

prompts.title: Spy Hunter
prompts.prompt: Build Spy Hunter as a multi-file web vertically scrolling combat-driving game. Accelerate and steer a sports car through traffic, destroying hostile enforcers while avoiding civilian vehicles. Enter a moving weapons van to install limited oil slicks, smoke screens or missiles in addition to the machine guns. Branch between roads and water sections where the car transforms into a speedboat, with bridges, narrow shoulders and helicopters. Include an opening grace timer, score, lives after grace, changing seasons and keyboard/gamepad controls.
prompts.watchFor: Civilian cars safe to destroy; weapons granted without matching the van; no road-to-boat transition; enemies indistinguishable from traffic; oil/smoke/missiles behaving alike.

prompts.title: Star Wars
prompts.prompt: Build the 1983 Star Wars arcade game as a multi-file web vector rail shooter. Use pointer/keyboard aim while the X-wing follows a three-stage run: dogfight TIE fighters and their fireballs, skim the Death Star surface shooting towers, then enter a trench filled with barriers and gun emplacements. Deflect incoming shots by shooting them, preserve a finite shield meter, and fire into the exhaust port at the trench end. Offer difficulty choice, wave loops, score bonuses for avoiding fire and responsive audio cues.
prompts.watchFor: Free-roaming flight instead of authored rail stages; shots cannot intercept enemy fire; shield meter absent; trench barriers non-colliding; exhaust-port climax automatic.

prompts.title: Tapper
prompts.prompt: Build Tapper as a multi-file web game. Dash among four bar lanes, fill and slide drinks toward advancing customers, and catch every empty mug they send back before it falls. Customers pushed to the door leave, while sending a drink down an empty lane costs a life; tips trigger a short dancing distraction/bonus. Add bar-specific layouts, mixed customer speeds, a shell-game bonus round, score, lives and rising service pressure with precise lane controls.
prompts.watchFor: Customers served instantly on button press; mugs not requiring catches; extra drinks harmless; all lanes sharing one queue; no tip distraction or bonus round.

prompts.title: Track & Field
prompts.prompt: Build Track & Field as a multi-file web sports game with alternating local players and six events: 100m dash, long jump, javelin, 110m hurdles, hammer throw and high jump. Rapidly alternate two run buttons to build speed, then use an action button with event-specific timing for jump angle, release angle or hurdle clearance. Enforce qualifying targets to continue, detect fouls, save records, and include event instructions, split-screen comparisons, score and keyboard/gamepad controls.
prompts.watchFor: Single-button mashing; events reduced to identical timing bars; no angle/release mechanics; qualifying failures do not end a run; fouls and records absent.

prompts.prompt: Build 1942 as a multi-file web vertical shooter over sea and islands. The fighter fires forward, collects weapon upgrades and has a small stock of loop manoeuvres that briefly dodge bullets by leaving the combat plane before returning. Script varied enemy formations whose complete destruction grants bonuses, include red power-up formations, large bombers with multiple hit points and a boss/target at each stage end. Add score, lives, loop counter, checkpoints and escalating bullet density.
prompts.watchFor: Loop as an unlimited screen-clear bomb; no visible leave/return arc or invulnerability window; random enemies instead of formations; power-up carriers absent; large planes dying in one hit.

prompts.title: Bomb Jack
prompts.prompt: Build Bomb Jack as a multi-file web single-screen platform game. Jump with controllable height and steer in the air through landmark-backed arenas to collect twenty bombs while enemies roam and transform. One bomb at a time is lit; collecting lit bombs in sequence builds a large end-of-round bonus, while power coins fill a meter that can temporarily freeze enemies and make them collectible. Add bonus-letter pickups, score, lives, several layouts and faster cycles.
prompts.watchFor: Rigid jump with no aerial control; lit-bomb order irrelevant; power meter not built from pickups; frozen enemies remain lethal; every stage uses the same layout.

prompts.title: Karate Champ
prompts.prompt: Build Karate Champ as a multi-file web one-on-one martial-arts game. Recreate the original dual-stick idea with paired keyboard/gamepad direction inputs that select a broad move set—high/low punches, kicks, sweeps, lunges, jumps and defensive retreats—rather than one generic attack button. A referee awards half or full points for clean hits, resets both fighters after each exchange, and first to two points wins. Include solo AI, local versus, timed bonus demonstrations and varied dojos.
prompts.watchFor: Health bars and button-combo brawling replacing judged points; tiny move set; exchanges not reset after a score; no half/full point calls; AI ignoring range and stance.

prompts.title: Kung-Fu Master
prompts.prompt: Build Kung-Fu Master as a multi-file web side-scrolling action game through five temple floors. Walk, crouch and jump while using fast punches and longer, higher-scoring kicks against grapplers, knife throwers, dragons, snakes and falling hazards.
